item.title: Munich Zoo Hellabrunn: A Visiting Guide with Kids and the Annual Ticket
item.description:
Today we are heading to the zoo in Munich again, Tierpark Hellabrunn. It is a wonderful place to visit with kids, especially on weekends. In this post, I explain how to get there, ticket prices, the annual pass, and what you need to know as a family with children.

Where is Hellabrunn, and what is it like?
#

Hellabrunn is located in the south of Munich, easily accessible from the city, and right on the banks of the Isar River. In that respect, its location is fantastic.

item.title: DB Familienticket: Round-Trip for 5 People for €99.99
item.description:
On weekends, we usually travel on regional trains with our two young sons using our Deutschlandticket (the nationwide public transit subscription). Traveling to another city on an ICE, however, is a whole different calculation with two adult tickets and separate seat reservations for everyone.

Deutsche Bahn introduced a family ticket this month: the Familienticket. It was tested last summer just for the school holidays; now it’s permanent. Sales started on October 26, 2026, and travel is possible from November 1, 2026 onwards.

item.title: The Ultimate Car Train Adventure: From Germany to Turkey with Ease
item.description: As Turkish families and expats living in Germany, the annual pilgrimage back home to Turkey is often a highlight of our year. It’s a journey filled with anticipation, longing, and the promise of reuniting with loved ones, enjoying familiar flavors, and soaking in the vibrant culture. However, the journey itself, especially with children, can be quite the undertaking. We’ve all been there: endless hours on the autobahn, navigating through multiple countries, the constant “Are we there yet?” from the backseat, and the sheer exhaustion that comes with driving thousands of kilometers. For years, we debated the best way to make this trip, weighing the pros and cons of flying and renting a car versus the traditional epic road trip. Then, we discovered a game-changer: the car train.
